Build the rein-app registration fixture per .ai/architect.md §3.5, §5, §9 (plan E-3): a test that installs the marketplace into a throwaway Claude workspace using the exact extraKnownMarketplaces entry and enabledPlugins map the rein-app Architect specifies (recorded as a D-### in .ai/DECISIONS.md — Q3 in architect.md §10; if not yet recorded when you reach this task, stop and ask the Architect, do not guess the shape). Acceptance: fixture installs every bundle listed in marketplace.json and fails with a named reason on a missing one; runs in CI; skips with a named reason when no rein release is available.

Move group 2 optional workflow units from rein per .ai/architect.md §2, §5, §9 (plan E-4): copy sre_responder, dependency_manager, meta_analyst, rein-triage, rein-upgrade, rein-insights, release-manager, token-miser into plugins/rein-ops; db_architect and rein-migration into plugins/rein-data. Same two-sided protocol as E-3: names unchanged (D-055), eval suite per bundle, a .ai/MOVES.md row per unit, then SendMessage `rein · Engineer` with the unit list. Do NOT move security_engineer, identity_guardian, scope_safety or trigger-audit (architect.md §10 Q2). Acceptance: rein-ops and rein-data pass `claude plugin eval`; publish scan zero hits; MOVES.md rows added; rein · Engineer notified.

Make the rein-seo bundle self-contained per .ai/architect.md §2 note and D-010: seo_content_generator and seo_manager currently abort unless rein-internal files exist (src/shared/seo-cluster-intents.mjs, .ai/blueprints/seo-keyword-multiplier.md). Ship the cluster-intents data inside plugins/rein-seo (as plugin-local data the agents resolve relative to the plugin root, not a rein path) and either ship the blueprint as a plugin template the agents scaffold into .ai/blueprints/ on first use or make its absence a clear, non-fatal prompt to the operator. Coordinate the intents move with rein · Architect (it is a group-1 dependency rein removes on its side). Acceptance: rein-seo eval passes in a workspace with no rein source checkout; no path under src/ or ~/.rein referenced by the bundle; MOVES.md row for seo-cluster-intents added.

Run CI once per PR per .ai/architect.md §7: restrict the workflow's `push` trigger to the main and stable branches so a PR branch push does not run the suite twice (push + pull_request). Go through skill: ci_gate first (CI change). Acceptance: a PR shows one workflow run per push; pushes to main and stable still run the full suite.

Add the GitHub-shorthand registration assertion to the E-4 fixture per .ai/architect.md §5, §9 and D-014: in CI (network available, isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), run `claude plugin marketplace add Vimurai/rein-plugins#stable --scope user` against the live public repo and assert the written settings.json has extraKnownMarketplaces["rein-plugins"].source.ref == "stable" and source.repo == "Vimurai/rein-plugins"; fail with a named reason [FIXTURE_REF_MISSING] if ref is absent, and report the result to the Architect (rein-app reopens its D-007 on that signal). Skip with [FIXTURE_SKIP_NO_NETWORK] when offline. Go through skill: ci_gate if the workflow file changes. Acceptance: assertion passes in CI against the live repo; the failure path is exercised with a bogus ref in a unit test.

Add rein-app's Q5 measurements to the E-4 fixture per .ai/architect.md §9 and D-016, report-only, one CI line each in the form `[FIXTURE_Q5_M<n>] <claude version> <result>`: M1 registration-by-start, unauthenticated, github source Vimurai/rein-plugins with ref "stable" (directory source until the remote has a tag) — after one `claude -p` start, does known_marketplaces.json carry ref "stable" and does the marketplace clone's HEAD equal origin/stable (a mismatch means silent trunk-tracking: tell the Architect the same day); M2 install-by-start, authenticated (CI secret), github source, three fresh config dirs holding only enabledPlugins {"rein-seo@rein-plugins": true} — count installs, record version and sha; M4 idempotence — `claude plugin marketplace add Vimurai/rein-plugins#stable --scope user` on a profile the session-start reconciler already registered exits 0, entry unchanged, no duplicate. (M3 is E-8.) Skips: [FIXTURE_SKIP_NO_CREDENTIAL] for M2, [FIXTURE_SKIP_NO_NETWORK] offline. Acceptance: all three lines appear in a CI run with the secret set; M2 skips cleanly without it; no filesystem path or account data in any line.
